#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify real auxiliary bytes, vector transport and the existing scalar contract in one session."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,runpy,shlex,subprocess,tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--configuration',required=True);p.add_argument('--stage',required=True);a=p.parse_args();folder=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='mach-msg2-aux-',dir=root/'runtime'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();guest=lambda p:'/Volumes/SystemRoot/workspace/'+str(p.relative_to(root));source=root/'fixtures/hello/mach-msg2-vector.c';sdk=root/'runtime/state/prefix/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk';obj=folder/'probe.o';exe=folder/'probe'
commands=[['clang-19','-target','x86_64-apple-macos11','-isysroot',str(sdk),'-O1','-g','-c',str(source),'-o',str(obj)],['ld64.lld-19','-arch','x86_64','-platform_version','macos','11','26.5','-syslibroot',str(sdk),'-lSystem',str(obj),'-o',str(exe)]]
scalar_source=root/'fixtures/hello/mach-msg2-scalar.c';scalar=folder/'scalar';scalar_obj=folder/'scalar.o'
commands += [[*commands[0][:-3],str(scalar_source),'-o',str(scalar_obj)],[*commands[1][:-3],str(scalar_obj),'-o',str(scalar)]]
aux_source=root/'fixtures/hello/mach-msg2-aux.c';aux=folder/'aux';aux_obj=folder/'aux.o'
commands += [[*commands[0][:-3],str(aux_source),'-o',str(aux_obj)],[*commands[1][:-3],str(aux_obj),'-o',str(aux)]]
for cmd in commands:subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
script=folder/'run.sh';script.write_text('#!/bin/bash\nulimit -c 0\nunset DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY XAUTHORITY\n'+shlex.join([guest(aux)])+' && '+shlex.join([guest(exe)])+' && '+shlex.join([guest(scalar),'115'])+'\nstatus=$?\nprintf "ACTIVATION_ROUTING_STATUS %s\\n" "$status"\nexit "$status"\n')
m=runpy.run_path(str(root/'scripts/direct-resource-tool-runtime-profile.py'));profile=m['profile'](stage=a.stage,configuration=a.configuration);env=m['environment'](profile);cmd=list(profile['command'][:-2]);scope=profile['direct_resource_environment']['tool_environment']
for key in ['DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH','DYLD_FRAMEWORK_PATH']:
 i=next(i for i,v in enumerate(cmd) if v.startswith(key+'='));cmd[i]=key+'='+scope[key]
cmd+=['/bin/bash',guest(script)];cmd[3]='100';log=folder/'run.log'
with log.open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
t=log.read_text();statuses=re.findall(r'^ACTIVATION_ROUTING_STATUS ([0-9]+)$',t,re.M);verified=r.returncode==0 and statuses==['0'] and 'MSG2_VECTOR_REAL_CAPTURED_HEADERS_SEPARATE_BUFFERS_EMPTY_AUX_AND_ERRORS_OK' in t and 'MSG2_SCALAR_CAPTURED_READONLY_TRANSPORT_AND_ERRORS_OK 115' in t and 'MSG2_AUX_REAL_BYTES_CROSS_PROCESS_RETRY_AND_LIFETIMES_OK' in t
record=dict(verified=verified,stage=a.stage,configuration=a.configuration,outer_status=r.returncode,native_statuses=statuses,source_runtime=profile['source_runtime'],command=cmd,build_commands=commands,log=str(log.relative_to(root)),log_sha256=sha(log),files={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),source,scalar_source,aux_source,script,root/a.stage,root/a.configuration]},full_goal_complete=False)
(folder/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(t[-4000:]);print('EVIDENCE',folder/'result.json');raise SystemExit(0 if verified else 1)
